Files modified: schema.ts (added suspendedAt), 0002_workspace_eviction.sql (added suspended_at column + index), eviction.ts (rewritten with two-phase logic + R2 cleanup), auth.ts (added touch to requireWorkspaceKey and requireAgentToken), worker.ts (updated cron to call both phases), test-helpers.ts and auth.test.ts (added lastActivityAt/suspendedAt to mocks).

retrospective.summary: Implemented two-phase workspace eviction: soft delete (suspend) at 30 days, hard delete with R2 cleanup at 60 days. Fixed activity tracking gaps in requireWorkspaceKey and requireAgentToken middleware.
